text: We discovered this place last weekend. We are again back this weekend. The food is awesome. I loved the Lamb. I came here for the Kababs, but liked the lamb and the gyro as well. It is not costly, so doesn't leave a hole in my wallet.
My go to for yummy Thai. Need vegan options, they have them. Food is consistently good. Always a treat.

Sat down at Johnny Sanchez on a Taco Tuesday for a quick bite before catching a flight out of town. Got a great glass of wine, a great meal, and great service all within 45 minutes. 

I ordered the Fried Catfish taco and the Albondigas taco (the latter being a rec by the waiter) and was very impressed. The fish taco was more of a standard fish taco among what I had in New Orleans that weekend, but the Albondigas was truly stand-out, and was very, very worth the $2 price tag. The waiter was exceptionally friendly about the relative rush that I was in, and brought out complimentary plantain chips with salsa to commemorate the end of what I had mentioned was an exceptional trip to NOLA. 

I was very impressed with the service at Johnny Sanchez, I was able to order within a few minutes of sitting down, and received my food roughly ten minutes later. There were tables around me that were definitely lingering for the happy hour, and there was no sense of urgency or rushedness about their tables. The overall environment was very relaxed, which I had grown accustomed to in NOLA. 

Johnny Sanchez is a great casual stop if you're looking for a quick, delicious bite in the Central Biz District.

The Blue Wedge is a new addition and is very good.  My wife had the salmon sliders and here only complaint was they got rid of the baby spinach.  Service was good, but the food was a little slow in coming out.
This is hands down my favorite po boy in the city!!! The roast beef is amaaaazing with the gravy. The beer is ice cold and the service is great.

One of my favorite local bakeries! They are always reliable for yummy sweets and pastries. 

They always have a variety assortment of small pastries, cakes, and cookies. They also have the BEST cannoli!! 

I love a little something sweet with a cup of coffee after dinner and their cookies and biscotti always hit the spot. 

A few favorites are the Apple puffs, chocolate Italian, and raspberry filled butter cookies, but they are all delicious. I try something new every time! 

Their lobster tails, tarts, and cakes are always a hit!

I was really excited to come here and had pretty high expectations based on the overall ratings, however, I was sadly disappointed from the moment I stepped in. Approximately 30 seconds after entering the establishment, waiting at the front counter and looking at the menu, my family and I noticed a woman who looked very confused hurriedly walk to the counter with her meal in hand. She examines the menu then her dish and proceeds to ask the nice woman/staff member behind the counter about why her dish is missing some ingredients that the menu claimed it would have. The cashier apologizes and takes the lady's meal to the kitchen. This is already a red flag that I should have known would foreshadow the rest of our experience there. We then made our orders: the daily hash brown special, the standard, and the avocado toast. As we proceeded to find a seat, we grabbed a few "clean" water cups. Once seated, we noticed that the cups seemed to still be tainted with white stains and a mysterious residue. Not to long after, our orders come out. After just taking a few bites, every last bit of hope we had had for this place completely diminished. The avocado toast was painfully bland and even unappetizing. The standard contained pieces of greenery that was borderline rotting. Finally, the hash browns were topped with browned, overripe avocado. We left the cafe feeling very unsatisfied and disappointed. I truly wanted to love this place. I would have honestly given this cafe a one star, bu
Food here and service is always good. I enjoy going here for fried cheese too. The tea is to die for. See you again when the saints win the super bowl this year!!!!

A pretty small restaurant, mostly carry out, in a strip mall. There are a few four seater booths. They stay extremely busy all the time. So much so that it's often difficult to get through on their phone lines (they have two numbers). 

They have numerous employees working, all of them working non-stop and as quickly and efficiently as possible. And they always have someone dedicated to working the resister and getting the orders out. 

The first two times we ordered carry out and picked it up, without checking the accuracy of the order before leaving, they left out the rice. 

That said, however, the food is great! And for that reason, we keep going back, about once a week. And since they are consistently busy with high volumes, just be patient. The food is worth the wait.

Customer Service is horrible. 
I went in to pick up my Togo order in which I paid for online. I was instructed by the host  to go to the bar to receive my order. Upon arrival to the bar I asked the bartender for my Togo order he then tell me I have to wait until for another person to hand me my order. I can physically see my bag in front of the bartender. How hard was it for him to confirm my purchase and just hand me my bag? This establishment has poor organizational & management  skills. I'd much rather the Magazine street location. 


Food: 

What's not up to my standards. Seemed pretty rushed. Not prepared with perfection.
The noodles are just regular spaghetti noodles the rice had no flavor definitely overpriced for the quality. Miso was decent.

Most don't think about breakfast here at Legend's, but they really do have nice breakfast choices, like my fav, a 1/2 lb burger patty served with eggs and real hashbrowns, none of this country potato stuff for me! They do hashbrowns right, not just a square of fried potatoes on a flattop, but fluffy hashbrowns and still crispy, just look at my pic! The burgers are killer here too!

I enjoyed the food so much, I came here twice in one week. I hadn't stepped foot here in nearly 10 years. 

Parking is okay. It can be harder to find a spot on weekends. Both times I went, I did not have to wait for a table though. Once you're seated, you are given a hot towel to clean your hands. It's cute on the inside. It has a downtown vibe but is located in the Grant Ave shopping plaza. 

Reasonably priced food. For the appetizer, I got edamame, which was a large portion. Big enough to share with 2 others. Only $4.50. I ordered the vegetable gyoza the second time around and that was $5. Both were fresh and delicious!

Service was good and the waitresses were friendly. They came to the table often to refill the water in my glass. 
I ordered a 5 piece crispy spicy tuna sashimi roll, $11. 
It literally melts in your mouth. You can also get this roll with salmon if you prefer. 

Although it isn't 50% off sushi, it's worth the price. I will be sure to stop in here again soon. It's so close to home and I never think to come here.

Grab and go in coffee shop, great coffee, pastries, ice cream, salads and meals to reheat at home. I picked up Shrimp Scampi over Veggie Pilaf and Shrimp and Grits (lunch and dinner) and they are both very good.  Frankly I think I'll pair these with a green salad and have 2 meals from each. Great staff ,and owner, and eats and very clean.  The owner is providing something for us and also giving staff hours and income so if you can stop in and give them business and don't forget to tip.

I'm making a revision to my rating, I'f I could give 0 stars I would. Leo's Italian Grill no longer deserves my business, Last year November 2020, Leo stormed over to our table & told my wife & I we were no longer welcomed at his restaurant!!!! The reason he gave was: my hand clapping & disco style dancing!!!!!!   I thought we lived in a free country,  I guess we do not!!!!!!    Prior to this incident we have been served  sour lasagna & stale chicken cutlet parmigiana.,  So Leo take your restaurant & the food poisoning & shove it where the sun don't shine,  you parasite!!!!!!!!

Want a good burger, or the best chicken wings?  Tiny's is the place to get them.  Great food and great service, everyone seems so happy to be  here customers and help, and we are aways happy when our travels to Tucson lead us to Tiny's!!   Try them out you won't be sorry!!

I may have caught them on a bad Sunday but the staff at the bar seemed more interested in changing TV channels than serving beer. After 10 plus minutes, did I mention hardly anybody was up on the top floor at like 3p, I got my beer and headed downstairs. Nice band, better service, and apparently a large bridal party with large "unique" water guns. First is funner and faster!
Consistently excellent. Any sandwich I've gotten here has been excellent. The Cuban by far is my favorite here. Cute little place that will keep you coming back.

Haven't been to this spot in quite some time.   Thought we would give it another try since they have a covered outdoor dining option.  We were greeted by hostess and sat promptly at our reservation time.  The first waiter Sebastiano came over to take drink request and offer specials.   He listed without enthusiasm which led us to believe they weren't that "special".   Another waitress came over and re ran down the list of specials.   We started with the fried calamari , pretty standard appetizer could have afforded some salt.  Which on the table was non existent since the salt shaker was a solid mass of salt and none came out when shaken.   We also tried the chicken croquette which was decent, different and didn't give off the southern Italian vibe but rather Jersey diner vibe.   We also had the salad with the artichokes, olives and capers which was great.  
      We opted for pasta dishes for dinner.   I chose the tortellini with pancetta and mushrooms.   The dish was good not heavy mushroom flavor which suited me fine.   The other person had the pasta with the porcini cream sauce, butternut squash and sausage.   The squash was not able to be seen, perhaps unrecognizable.  It was just ok.   They only finished 1/3 of the dish which led me to believe that they didn't care for it.   The third person had pasta mushroom fettuccine.  It was underwhelming to say the least.   Nothing wowed us and made us want to return.   The company was good and the wine was
also good because we br

Right now, this restaurant is take out ONLY. We ordered the 8 piece chicken with sides of coleslaw and macaroni and cheese. The chicken was moist and delicious--including the breast which is usually dry. The coleslaw had a sweet taste to it and the macaroni and cheese was creamy. They included forks and spoons so we went to a park and had a picnic. I'd eat here again.
Great beer and equally great tour.  Definitely my favorite beer brewer in STL - looking forward to visiting again.  5-stars!

I really love this restaurant because the food are so tasty! Especially i love the spicy curry powder chicken. The overload ribs tastes amazing as well. I really love this restaurant!! It's clean, and the waitresses are nice. Highly recommend!!!

This dump should be closed. Dirty, food disgusting. Went in at 1215 to get the buffet. One pizza out, lettuce and dressing. That's it. ONE person working doing it all. Waited, 10 min later cinnamon sticks, no pasta no additional salad sides. Eventually another pizza and some macaroni (single serving). Absolutely nothing positive to say about this dying joint. Don't waster your money time or appetite.

9/2020: we finally made it back over here to experience some of their amazing food again! We were not disappointed. We got there around 8:15pm (they close at 9pm on Tuesday's now) and were seated immediately. Our server Trish was absolutely wonderful! Even though it was so late in the evening and close to their closing times she gave us phenomenal service with a smile! Parking can be tight here but they have overflow parking back behind the restaurant.

I ordered The seafood pasta which includes clams shrimp and scallops and a beautiful garlic white wine sauce with linguine noodles. It was delicious! My husband ordered the special, salmon with a crabcake and shrimp skewers but he also added the Felix on top of it for the extra lobster affect. Again the food was amazing! We ended up taking food home with us and eat it the next day for lunch and it still tasted just as amazing.

Highly suggest checking them out for an incredible meal! 

We brought my mother down to Treasure Island to show her the area and she really wanted some good seafood. After reading a few reviews on Yelp, Shells was on our list as a potential spot. While we were walking along the John's Pass area we overheard some random strangers and business owners talking about how good the food was at Shell's - word of mouth sealed the deal of where we were going to have dinner. 

We arrived around 8:30pm on a sunday night. There was plentry of parking and we were impressed with the mister fans outside the restaraunt.

Open for takeout or delivery thurs - Sunday, abbreviated menu on their FB page. Picked up dinner and beers Friday night, called 20 mins out and it was waiting for me! Amazing food and beer breaking up house arrest monotony.  Go git some!
I like this this place even though they make you coffee burn your face off hot they have really cute cups to

This spot had the COVID protocols down and moves the lines for take out quickly. The food is just as good to go as it is in person and the packaging for take out ensures it is hot and no spills on the ride home. Packaged cold foods together, which I really appreciated!!!
Very good tasty seafood; you cannot eat there and if you don't order in front of time, there might be a long waiting time

This is my new FAVORITE Thai place now. I originally ordered takeout but I saw that they have an outdoor seating set up when I went to pick up my food. Both times I ordered the drunken noodles cause they were so DELICIOUS. The service was great and we got our food so quick. We also got the Thai tea which was super yummy. My boyfriend had beef garlic rice and he loved it. The Thai tea is $3.50. The drunken noodles were ~$12. There was so much food but I ate it all because it was so good.

Proudly displayed in the window is a 'The best of Montco 2019 Best Zep's'  sign.  I have had good Zep experiences, and apparently Eve's are the best, so I ordered one.  The large zep was $14.50, you know I am not a fan of that.  I will give Eve major props.  She had a sign up that due to price increases during COVID there was an additional charge sandwiches (above the $14.50).  It's a pandemic, people understand you have to pass the increase on to the consumer, supermarkets do it.  The large zep was very good.  It is on a very good but very bready roll.  Sneaky good amount of good meat.  I prefer the meat chopped but it was good.  I would have liked a little bit more cheese.  The zep flavor overpowered everything but that is what I guess it is supposed to do.

Food was so amazing! But this was the worst service I've experienced in a long time. The service ruined a good and expensive meal. We would of gotten more drinks, tapas and desserts but were not asked once if we were okay or wanted more. A few feet from us the other server was at the bar offering customers discounted bottles of wine, however we were not asked if we wanted another drink. Very bad and unprofessional. Too bad because we had high hopes of making this a frequent restaurant as we live very close to it.
Great variety of rotating Cajun menu items. We were given a small sample of the available options to make our choice. Food was good. Service great and value hard to beat.
Always great food for a reasonable price. Service is always great someone always greet you with a smile as you walk in the door. Love this restaurant for a chain restaurant it's damn good!

***** Five Stars! *****
We really enjoyed our tour with you this past weekend...and Bobby Thomas was a GREAT tour guide; we would highly recommend him!!
We have been to New Orleans before, more than once, but we enjoyed learning quite a bit more about your city with Bobby; he certainly seems to be a knowledgeable and experienced tour guide, whose wit, sense of humour, and presentation of some of New Orleans more *interesting* (and less known) stories made the tour worthwhile...plus, he is adorable!
Bobby was also very good with our group, some of whom had consumed one Hurricane too many, as we were there celebrating the 50th birthday of my husband and his friend - ha ha!
Thank you again; we hope to enjoy another tour with you on one of our future visits to your lovely city...

Such a pleasant surprise! Firstly, we got a Saturday brunch reservation 20 mins before, lol. That is CLUTCH for last minute plans and serious hunger ;) Secondly, our server, Emily, was TOP NOTCH! She took care of us like a pro and had the BEST personality. She made our entire brunch perfect - from start to finish. Thirdly, the food was sooooo very good. Hubby had the steak and eggs and I had the Greek omelet. He devoured his steak and I loved the flavor in the Greek omelet! Honestly, anything with feta cheese, spinach, and onions will make me happy (hahaha). Not to mention, the egg whites made me feel super healthy ;) Their house potatoes are really tasty and round out the brunch nice and "heartily." Even the pastries and yogurt were fresh and delicious! Had we not been so full, we may have had to try out their delicious desserts and ice cream ;) Other guests seemed to like their Bloody Mary and mimosa bars as well.

It's in the JW Marriott hotel, so it may be kind of a "hidden gem" to anyone outside of the hotel. Now that we've found it?? We'll definitely be back. Five stars!

We were staying across the street at the Hilton hotel and decided to try breakfast here. We both had the eggs Benedict with home fries and pancake. The food came out hot and fresh and the service was excellent. The café has a home style atmosphere and was cozy. I recommend coming here and will try it again during my next stay in Clearwater.

This hurts to write. We have been regulars for 3 years almost now. We have always been able to make a reservation because we normally come with a group of 10+. I called tonight to make that reservation I'm used to having to make...only to be told they don't take them anymore. I asked since when and was abruptly hung up on. I tried calling back and she picked up just to hang up on me without saying anything. Yes they have caller id. Seeing that we've been there one too many times I know this. Absolutely rude and absurd. Considering the only reason we cake was for the food because the service has never been great this solidified it for us and we will be finding a new sushi place to spend our money at.

I love this place, it is family owned seat down Chinese restaurant, one of the last few Indy, they have been operating for 31 years and the guy that started it is still running it. Their food is good and they have great rotating dinner specials, the servings are huge! I can say that 2 dinner orders can feed 3-4 people depends on how hungry you are. I suggest getting their Mongolian beef because it is delicious. All their food is made to order so don't expect your food to be brought out within 3 mins. This place is kind of old so the decor is a little bit outdated still homely though.
Food 9/10
Service 8/10
Atmosphere 6.5/10

Had great veggie experience here. The veggie fresh rolls were delicious and super light. Also had the lemongrass tofu sammich, bread was nice and soft and the tofu made really well, came with a bit of jalapeño for a perfect amount of heat. 
We walked in and ordered from counter and waited outside. Guy at counter was efficient and nice.
just one advice for u guys: don't try to order the old chicago special pizza, it's fkin salty.

Gotta get every sauce they have.

Kids burger
- mnp says it's good
- love the Slider portion
- would recommend for adults to try more burgers

Fun guy
- mama likes

Bison
- good flavor is very similar to beef but drier

Truffle fries
- perfect crisp, love the cut

Purple fries
- good but russets are better
- mnp says they're ok

Great food and great service! This is my second visit and it did not disappoint!!! Breakfast and lunch are great but my favorite is lunch! So many tasty and healthy choices! Great service and great ambience also!!!

I visited Mitchell's for Thanksgiving Day this year. Though this wasn't my top pick I definitely think I'd go back there again next year for turkey day! The seasonal menu had a ton of great options. But I'd have to say my absolutely favorite was their charboiled oysters! Best ones that I've had; they were seasoned perfectly and not overcooked.

We always love coming here. Sometimes we split a pasta, the portions are so big that you definitely can! Our favorites are the fettuccini weesie and the shrimp and scallop linguine. Tried the fettuccini carrabba today and it was also delicious. The chicken soup is 12/10, and if you have room for dessert, the chocolate dream is a literal dream.
I've been eating there since the day it opening.  Never a bad meal.  Always quality meats and sides.  Great staff.
Found a hair in my omelette like it was mixed in with the eggs and all they did was take the drink off the bill. I come here every Sunday not any more. Gross check your food before you eat

I went here the other night as one of our stops while bar hopping. We didn't get any food so i can't rate on that but what I can say was the pretty bartender with the tattoos and red hair was AMAZING! She actually made me a hot tea because she could tell I was getting over a cold ! 
She also made the best old fashions we've ever had ! So 5/5 for service and drinks

I will be back but I will say my first impression was not the greatest!! Was greeted at the door with a YELL of "welcome". To me that was not a pleasant welcome, since I was screamed at. There was a cook up front and out of the kitchen during our whole dinner, groping, hanging, grabbing and flirting with all the servers, he made me VERY uncomfortable the whole time. Now on to the servers, there were about 55 cheerleaders walking around. Looking bored, waiting for a napkin to fall on the ground so they actually had something to do. Goodness gracious, how do any of them make any money? We had fried pickles and the serving size was honestly scary, so large it could have fed a whole entire family and were also too thin, they tasted like air! But the rest of our dinner was great! Our server Megan was absolutely amazing and will request her when I give this place another try!

I arrive at Bula Kafe to find that the bar is manned by a tender named Conner, who dislikes me personally. For ten minutes I stand unacknowledged, and watch six people arrive and place their orders. I get Conner's attention and ask to speak with him when he's finished his current task. He looks at me without responding. I wait another five minutes and watch five more people served in a timely, friendly fashion. When Conner addresses the entire bar asking "Who wants a shell?" I leave, and ask a friend to order on my behalf. She returns with a drink in under two minutes. 

I have only ever been kind and courteous to this business and it's employees, and my money and time are as valuable as the next customer's. If I wanted this kind of treatment I'd go back to high school instead of going to a kava bar. Everything about Bula Kafe, and everyone that has served me here in the last few years, has been fast, fair, and enjoyable, with the exception of this experience and this bartender. I hope things are different next time.

I go to the location at Fort Ben, The atmosphere in the restaurant is not very cozy as the ceilings are high and the floor is concrete.
I prefer the bar area.(which is a little better) The pizza is always good and consistent. There are some strange   Combinations, but to each his own.
Staff are usually quite young, but get the job done.
Great place for families...not good for a quick lunch, as it takes a minute to make their food.

What's wrong with this place? Why do they book takeout pickup orders at specific times and never actually get the order out anywhere near the time booked? If I book a holiday meal pickup up 3:15pm then maybe you have the meal ready close to 3:15pm? Not say 4:07pm and I'm still waiting. Management knows the kitchens capacity right? Take orders based on the capacity. It's ok to tell customers 2 days before that you can't do it. Communicate.

Absolutely amazing! Please walk in early and make a reservation it is a fairly busy restaurant. Everything we ordered was fantastic! Real fast, efficient and friendly service by our server. Definitely going back!

The twist on this classic BLT is the goat cheese adds a nice creamy texture on the palate. You have an option of adding a salad or potato chips as a side. The pineapple ginger lemonade is the ride balance of sweet & tart with a kick ( that's the ginger). Outdoor seating available, nice staff.

We always buy the key lime pie from Mike's Pies. It's sweet, tart & delicious! Their chocolate pies are also really good. You can't go wrong with any of them. They're a perfect alternative to birthday cakes  or other celebratory events.

I recently visited Tharios Kitchen, the owners are amazing and very welcoming! This is my new favorite spot the food is full of flavor the Lasagna is hands down the best I've ever had and worth the drive from Los Angeles.

I can't wait to go back, If you happen to be in the area or even for a getaway I highly recommend you stopping by.

9-13-19 Lunch for 2   1:30PM

Parking - Excellent 
Ambiance - Very pleasing to the eye. Asian eye appeal ...simple @ clean lined. Good view of Chef. 
Menu - Well detailed and easy to read. Separate order sheet for  sushi. 
Manager/waitress - very helpful with us in making a selection.  Excellent recommendations for us. 
Note: they are strict with using Groupon....evening meal menu only...no exceptions. 18% tip automatically included on bill. 

Pad Thai's we're absolutely SUPERIOR......best I've ever eaten.  

Restroom - This could have more attention and improved upon. It doesn't follow the beautiful standard of the restaurant. 
I look forward to returning soon.

This place is right by our house, and so we got it one night. Last minute and starving, and it PAID off! Great portions, great food. Best chicken on a stick from one of these fast Chinese restraurant's I've had in Nashville. I usually get the shrimp and broccoli and it's so much food for the price. Definitely a great place to make your regular take out food.

Last night my husband took me to Golden Corral for dinner. I was really looking forward to it. For so long the food was terrible, but about a year ago or so the food improved so much that we loved to eat there. It was delicious for quite awhile. Now I don't know what has happened, but the food quality has once again gone way down. Many fried things are burnt to a crisp. The 5 types of wings were not good at all. They were over cooked and dry. The sauces were not even flavorful. Once again, what they offer is not worth the price.// This morning we came for the breakfast buffet and I have to give it 5 stars!! The breakfast buffet has everything you could ask for.  Biscuits and gravy, toast and chip beef gravy, corn beef hash, scrambled eggs, all types of Dixon's to put in your scrambled eggs, a lady that makes omelettes to order, taters, taters with cheese, Mexican food, fried chicken, bacon, sausage links and patties, fresh fruit, milk-White and chocolate, fruit juices, salads, desserts, banana nut bread, and more! WHEW!

I will defend Imo's pizza to my grave.

I flew toasted ravioli out of state for my wedding.

I spent years getting provolone gifted to me at Christmas. 

I am a hardcore, die hard St. Louis girl. So now you know where I'm coming from when I ask --

Have you ever eaten pasta so terrible it makes you feel sorry for yourself?

Baked mostaccioli with meatballs: it's not baked, and they forgot the meatballs. 

Let me be clearer-- the cheese was baked. But those are boiled noodles. My beloved cheese turned to plastic -- and I put this cheese on my own stuff when I bake pasta, so what did they do to this? Heat lamp? And the sauce-- 

Can you accept this description with the sadness I am trying to convey?

The sauce just tastes *wet*.

Damn this is disappointing. I was trying to treat myself. And as a $10+ item, I kind of assumed there'd be the tiniest bit of finesse. 

I know. I'm taking my pasta purchase personally.  But it's a damn shame.
The best barbecue. So delicious! Everything is good and the service was great. Would definitely go back and would recommend.

Great atmosphere and delicious gourmet pizzas. They have a bar too. 

The pizzas are made of all quality ingredients and are always fresh.

The manager and hostess were amazing and they have bottomless mimosas. The jambalaya was the best part of the meal though. My omelet was terrible, the gumbo left something to be desired and most of our food came out wrong. We waited over an hour to be seated but the manager was really friendly about it. The waitress was way to busy to pay attention to our table and we were often times looking around for someone. I would like to see what their lunch menu has but I won't order anything with eggs here again. I'll probably only come again for the bottomless mimosas

We found it just by walking down the street. I had the jumbo wings and it was the best fried chicken in French Quarter.  Spicy and crispy. My husband had a jumbo sampler. 
If we had stayed longer we were have gone back. Give it a try.

I have been coming to Shrimp Store for years and have always enjoyed it but after today I will never go back. We ordered our food and the server brought out just one persons order.and we asked about it she got mad and said you will have to pay for that rolled her eyes and continued to tell my daughter that she didn't have time for this. We demanded a manager and all he would do was make excuses stating everyone is just upset by COVID. Our nice lunch was ruined by the staff they were rude and when we left the same waitress tried to start another argument by yelling out "I hope your day gets better. Our day was just fine until we entered the restaurant. I will never eat their again I have never had such horrible service in my life.

The best!!!!

Everything is great but the grilled cheese is like nothing you've ever had before. Their own ipa and double ipa are perfect.
This location can be easily missed. It's a nice hole in the wall place. The Mac n cheese was tasteful and I highly recommend getting toppings. This makes a big difference on the experience there.

Damn!

A little history...... I managed a Chinese Restaurant way back in the early 80s.  It was a restaurant focused on both the food and the experience.   The family I managed the restaurant were authentic,  real and committed to their craft.  

Fast forward 30 years..... I had almost given up on finding good, quality Chinese food.  I had almost made this a religious quest!

By chance, a Yelp search yielded Joy!  Yep, Joy..... Joy Chalet.  Funny that that's their name.

Now- crafting a truly quality Chinese dish requires timing.... you just don't add the broccoli with the shrimp...... nor do you keep the hot and sour soup on hold in a steam table!

The best Chinese cuisine I have had in over 30 years- this is quality food!

We just had one meal..... tomorrow is another day.

Thinking ... Sushil tomorrow... their Sushi menu looks just as fabulous!!!!

Edit...... Day 2, we came back for dinner........

Better than yesterday, we brought a friend - he enjoyed the food, Jeff and everyone.

I ordered my food at 7pm and the driver arrived at 9pm, I used the app and it showed it went from quality check bake to bake. I was notified my driver left at 8:17pm and then I heard nothing. I called the store and the workers seemed confused on what was going on. Then they said it was on its way and didn't confirm a time range or vehicle to look for. When my food did arrive the driver seemed agitated and my pizza was dry like it had been sitting in the heating/warming rack for an hour or more. I threw half the pizzas I ordered away and deleted the Domino's app.
Got bad food at b.k  with this whopper you did not see the tomatoes  was bad  so this is just not right how could you just put this on a burger  and not see its bad

I came into town for business. Didn't want to drive anywhere so I decided to just go here because it was on hotel property.
There were only three other tables of patrons. I sat on the patio which had a beautiful view and was relaxing.
I was told the card reader was down so I my cash. This impacted what I ordered as I dug through my purse for some cash. 
Waiter brought water, chips and very small cup of salsa.
He came back and took my order. Then disappeared for 30 minutes. I finally went in to find him to ask about my food. He apologized and said he'd check on it.
My food came out about five minutes later. All I ordered was 1 taco and a aide of beans. 
Not the best carne asada taco, but it was ok. Beans were very bland. 
The server again was very apologetic. And he took off the charge for the beans.
Wish I'd made the effort to drive someplace.
Best Gyros / Chicken & Lamb platters  I've ever tried, and I've been to a lot of Halal Carts around Philly and NYC. My favorite dish is the Lamb Shishlik. Highly-Highly....Recommend!

I had heard a recommendation for Good Buddy from an acquaintance of mine who was originally from China, so a few years later the opportunity came and I gave it a try...

I ordered the lunch meal for one with the Shanghai noodles. It also came with chicken fried rice and mixed vegetables with beef. I ordered on the phone - didn't want to order over Facebook as per their website. 

They called me back when the meal was done - nice touch. It was ready in 15 minutes, just like they said. 

I brought home the lunch in a big styrofoam container, and I must say the portion was HUGE: perhaps as much as three lunch-size portions. 

The Shanghai noodles were salty, chewy, and satisfying. The chicken fried rice was pretty standard; some scrambled egg and peas thrown in for protein. The beef was lean and the vegetables were just the right done-ness. 

All in all, a satisfying Chinese takeout experience with massive portions. Exceptional? Not really, but good value for money.

Update. Came back to give them a second chance months later. We were seated immediately. Our order was promptly taken. Food was hot and quickly came. Server, Caleb H, was very attentive. Moved them from one to five stars after today. Thanks! 

Older. Sat for 10 minutes with no service. Had to call someone over to take our order. Meanwhile others seated after us were taken care of. Unfortunately this has happened at multiple locations. Service all around is just poor. Use to love this restaurant.

Ordered online. I got to the very end and it wouldn't let me continue because it said my phone number was already assigned to another customer. I called in and they said it happens all the time. Gave them my order and they set for carry out and not delivery like I had requested. Called 50 minutes later to check on order and they said they made a mistake and they would have my pizza to me in 10 minutes. I asked if it would be the same pizza that had been sitting around for the last half hour. They said yes. Cancelled order and they lost me as a customer forever.

We've been about four times now, a couple of times for hot and cold subs, a couple times for entrees - all really good.  We like the bread, meats and their red sauce.  I'd like more garlic on the garlic bread, please!  Good for takeout in these Covid times - pick up subs for lunch and you can get ready-to-go from the fridge spaghetti or lasagna to reheat for dinner later!
Was looking for a place my 85 yo mother in law would like, so I read her a review saying "nothing has changed in decades." She was all in and loved it. Made some new friends too. All smiles :)

These guys are amazing. I ordered a feast for a work colleague whose family is going through a tough time. Ordered to pick up but my car got stuck in the ice and I couldn't get out of my drive way. Food was all ready for pick up. I called and they volunteered to take it and deliver to my colleagues house which is out of their footprint. Who does that? In an ice storm? In a pandemic? With a chain? This Taziki's that is who does that. Will be coming back to this place forever!!!! A little good news...good deeds. Thank you Taziki's!!!

This review is pure nostalgia for a place where I had some of my most enjoyable meals and tea/dessert pairings in Tucson. I loved their preservation of the building's history but everything else was always, always, always first-rate as well. Wherever you live it's always great to know of a local restaurant which never disappoints - whether you just need/want a little morale lift for yourself or are introducing someone new to it.

Mine were all afternoon visits so I can't vouch for their rooms or musical events - my idea of nightlife is stargazing in some remote spot to a concert of "rushing creek, popping campfire, crickets and night birds." So my only brush with one of this venue's events was accidentally wandering too close to the concert entrance area one late, darkening afternoon and encountering a brutish security guard who looked like he wanted to tackle me for it - well, you might have people who try to sneak in but I wasn't one of them you cretin!  But that's pretty typical security guard behavior, I'd never reduce a rating for that unless it was an ongoing thing.

I'm planning a visit to Tucson this year and this will be my first stop; Cafe Poca Cosa my second (AMAZING food) - have missed them both so much!!
Delicious authentic fresh pasta. The portions are very large and reasonably priced. Perfect go to place for a quick take out meal!
This place is truly a neighborhood gem! Food is always hot, fresh, and tasty. Service for takeout is lightening quick. I keep their menu by the phone as a permanent fixture, and it is well worth it.

Sparking rose was delicious! Stayed for one drink and the complimentary child care!!! That's right, there's an indoor play space with a sitter next door. Tips only and they watch your kids while you drink and dine! Huge win esp since we were traveling from out of town and wanted. Break from the kiddos!

My nieces and myself went last night and had a great time. The waitress Sierra was very nice and pleasant. Every time she came to the table she had a smile on her face. We never had to wait on our bread or drinks to be refilled. She told us about the specials they were offering. I love this location. It made us feel like family when the manager Ryan came over and talked to us. The food was hot and fresh. Shout out to the chefs that made our food. They have great customer services. Keep up the great work. Sierra you are awesome and I wish it was more people like you. Thank you for your great work.
My go to Indian restaurant in the bay. All of their chicken dishes are seriously so yummy, and the staff is super polite.

I really don't know what to say about this place. Not only is the food amazing but I'll say it's best Thai I've ever had. Service was great owner/chef comes to the table. Drink menu could be a bit better but the food mayne... the food was fire

We ordered sweet and sour pork - the food was awful - the pork was very tough.  The service was another story - she forgot about us and it took over 35 minutes to get our order. It wasn't until we were going to leave that we got our food and she brought 2 egg rolls - which we didn't order, and another 15 minutes to get the pork!!

Great burgers, great fries, great atmosphere. Very attentive staff. The cook checked up on me to make sure my medium rare burger was cooked good for my liking which was nice. Great prices for how great the food is. Definitely have gone back multiple times and have recommended it to many friends!

A quick shoutout to Louies Wine Dive in Clayton.  Our daughter turned 21 yesterday and had planned to go there with a group of 16 for dinner.   I called on Thursday to ask if they could make a cake. We live out of state. The woman that answered the phone (Stacey) said they didn't do cakes (she did offer other dessert options but a cake is our tradition) But, she would be happy to personally stop by on her way home and order a cake, buy candles, go back to pick it up and make sure she got it back to the restaurant on Friday.  I honestly couldn't believe it.    True midwestern hospitality at its finest.  Not only do they have excellent food,  their employees are simply the best.

Underwhelming...i don't understand why its called  French Bakery... How is a chorizo omelette with goat cheese french? and so home done. (Order was wrong, asked for a crepe got omelette instead.)
Staff is friendly. Will only come back for the latte and ambiance. Latte was delicious.

I was tempted to go 4-stars here and I still may come around if I eat here again (something I'm willing to do). I had a Mcdougal Sandwich, which is basically a pita sandwich with both falafel and shawarma. My girlfriend got a basic falafel sandwich and we split an order of fries with garlic sauce.

I started out very happy with the my sandwich - the lamb shawarma meat surprised me with how flavorful and "real" it tasted. And by and large I enjoyed the sandwich. As I went on, though, I noted that the falafel was taking a serious backseat to the lamb and the lettuce/tomato - there were I think two balls in there, but their presence in the taste and texture was minimal. My girlfriend somewhat similarly felt that there was a disproportionate amount of lettuce and tomato (as well as disappointed that the place doesn't seem to offer cucumber with any dishes), somewhat at the expense of the falafel. 

The fries also elicited mixed feelings. Make no mistake - they taste exactly like I wanted them to. They were lightly seasoned and a perfect mix of outwardly crisp and internally billowy. But at $4.55, the portion was way too small - we would not have split them had we known how few you get...but we also would't have spent $9+ on two small bags of french fries, so damned if you do, damned if you don't there. The garlic sauce was a letdown, too - more than tasting garlicky, it was salty enough to choke a horse. It worked out because they tasted great alone and with ketchup, but the garl

Great place for brunch. My husband and I tried this cafe out this morning for the first time and were extremely pleased! We both had crab cake eggs Benedict and deep fried French toast and it was heavenly! The coffee was delicious. Definitely coming back.

First time visitors on a weekday afternoon. Our gourmet cheeseburgers were memorably succulent. A burger I could literally sink my teeth into. Attentive service.Ambiance is merely average, but we'll be back.

My new favorite place! They have the best falafel sandwich ive ever had and their fries are fresh cut! I got a lunch combo for 7.99 with a drink. They even had a vegetarian falafel philly cheesesteak im going to try next time. Family owned and great friendly people. I reccomend to try them im sure anything they make is great.
Amazing authentic Italian! Chef William is very kind and his food is amazing! I definitely would recommend to anyone.
Trenton Social is an excellent bar, everyone that works there are very kind and that includes the owner. The food is great and drinks are amazing. It is definitely my go to spot.

An absolute legendary destination.  When you say Cheesesteak, most people think of Geno's.  Everything is made to order.  The nice thing about Gino's is they take cash and credit.  They have two windows, one for cheesesteaks and the other one for fries and drinks.  That way they can whip out them sandwiches just as fast as possible.  The bread is fresh, firm and has great flavor.  It holds up to the meats cheeses and sauces.  The meat is a little thicker than others and the flavor comes across as a little salty.  But as far as cheesesteaks are concerned, Gino's is the absolute top.  Make sure you order it wit or witout onions and your choice of cheese.  For me, it's all about the cheese wiz!  But hey,  you do you!

The location is just layered with pictures of celebrities and badges from police forces around the world.  There are even pictures on the ceiling.  You can spend quite awhile just looking at all the swag.  And don't forget to get your Gino's gear.  Hats, shirts and an assortment of items to show you know where the best is!
Worst Buffalo Wild Wings restaurant in the city. Bad customer service and they are always under staffed.
Simple, super fast, and really nice staff. Love the Poke! It's our go to spot for a warm Ramen during these colder evenings.

I wish I can give this place 0 stars 99% of the workers there look like they need to go to rehab and act like your there asking for free food they need to fire everyone there disgusting attitudes  an horrible service

Wondered into this place not knowing what to expect. Our bartender/server was extremely helpful, and heather was extremely kind and attentive as well. Definitely recommend as a nice, neighborhood home in the wall!

La Teresita Cafe was really awesome and very affordable. Super clean. So many good choices here, I was impressed with the menu, tried their Cafe Con Leches and it was magnificent. Incredibly courteous, attentive and professional. You won't be unsatisfied.

So I had to come and check out Ararios for myself and I am so pleased that I did. Korean fusion at its best and an exceptional bartender/mixologist gives you eclectic and drinks to tantalize your taste buds. 

I would be wrong I telling you to try one dish when they all are amazing. I'd love to learn the Korean word for "Umami" which in Japanese means the five tastes and combination that is complete tasting experience. 

We sat at the bar and enjoyed the ambience and energy of the restaurant. Great place for a first date, friends and family gatherings and solo diners can enjoy the full bar with TV's.
I just love it here good drinks any time of day and good vibes they have games beach service and good loves bands.
Just ordered takeout, food was Excellent, so glad they have re-opened. We had falafel & hummus.

Went here for brunch - the food sounded so good so maybe it was just my expectations were high but everything was just fairly good. Worth the try and great drink options. Service was good but I just hoped for more.
Food and service is always consistently good. Their specials are a great deal. Somethings can be a little expensive though on the menu for what you get.

The food is normally fresh . Today's experience was poor. Another couple that arrived after us got their meal before we got waters. Everything was cold - steak, beans and rice. Service was very poor and caused this experience to be disappointing.

Um, hell yes.  The hubby and I stopped in on our way out of Santa Barbara on a whim and I'm so glad we did.  

First of all, the donuts are almost too pretty to eat.  Almost.  I ordered the fig honey yeast donut which was sweet with the ripest fig I've ever tasted.  Delicious.  My husband went the chocolate route and devoured the s'mores donut.  

We also added 4 donut holes which were simple yet amazing.  Those were by far my favorite because they were small, sweet and petite.

This place has really declined- I was here last summer and the food and service were excellent. Last night was awful. 
The food was simply not good. The service was worse. The server got the orders mixed up, didn't supply us serving utensils for our tables shared appetizers. Worse, the beets in the beet salad were not cooked. When we brought it to the attention of the server, instead of taking it away she said," I'll go talk to the kitchen and you can just munch on that". Cool, because I just love raw beets. She then came back and informed us that the beets had been boiled for 4 hours, and the reason I thought they were raw was because they were chilled. Umm no, when you can barely cut a beet with a knife it is simply not done. The Trout was not fresh and they messed up the temp on the Beef Medallions ( switched temps with the two people who ordered at the table). When I asked for limes for my San Pellegrino they were bright in a napkin and all stuck together. Also, I love paper napkin shreds in my water with my raw beets. Last, the server proclaimed "It's Friday night, you have to drink!" Ummm, no I don't have to drink and if I do it would have grave repercussions. 
It was a pretty bad experience with a big price tag.

Love this place and everything about it. Was a customer for at least two years. I know the times are tough and everyone doing everything they can! 

BUT, 
recently customer service just stopped being as friendly as it has been before. The business accepts online and at-a-door orders, I know this for a fact as I observed it almost every day. But recently I was rudely turned away when I wanted to treat my out of town friend to coffee and Benna's amazing bagels. One of the employees said to please put order online with a very significant fake and loud "thaaank youuuu" at the end. Which of course I didn't. 

Love the food. The owner makes amazing lattes, by the way, highly recommend.

Unfortunately one of the employees spoiled it for me for good.
So glad to see Nitally's back in business! This is a local staple and is so unique. I would like to swim in a bathtub full of the panang mole sauce.

I've been here once before and I remember liking it, but not this time. The two calzones were very small, maybe the size of my hand, and the diavolo had so much sauce it looked more like soup than pasta. Add to that flavorless buttered noodles for my daughter and that's 50 dollars I should have spent elsewhere. Staff was nice.

It's one of the places you're reluctant to 
review in a 5 Star rating thinking it would be impossible to get your order in on the next call for pickup
Everyone on staff are delightful 
Love the experience

This is an overlooked spot and it's one of my favorites. Kid friendly atmosphere, but you still feel separate from other tables if you are going with someone special. Lighting is somewhat dim in the evening. They have great lunch specials for sushi and meals. Best hot and sour soup in the city and I have tried a lot! They also have an all you can eat sushi place next door owned by the same business. Right now they do not have dine-in option due to covid-19, but you can still place lunch special orders to-go. The dynamite roll is one of my faves. There is plenty of parking. You can either call to place your order or you can walk up to the window. 10/10 hands down. This is my restaurant to go to on the weekends for a quick lunch special sushi roll ensemble after I do my grocery shopping. Happy eating...

Never ever again. Over charged our large party by more than $100. Over charged for 4 seniors in our group. Over charged for children in our group. Added more people than we had. Bathrooms were horrific! Then when my daughter in law went back to go over the bill they (particularly the rude little man in the front!) gave a very hard time and were extremely rude. Things he said to her as a customer is the main reason I decided to write this review. Actually a ZERO star rating but wouldn't let me post without one.

I wonder how often people update their reviews to keep the same low score. For one I despise the place and only ended up here because someone throwing an event I wanted to attend threw it here. Much to my dismay but not surprisingly the conditions are the same. Snarky rude bartenders, unwelcoming atmosphere, it's a pretty place but the food and attitudes aren't edible. I waited forever to get a drink order, only words uttered were "you can't stand near the service area" and the tender quickly walked away after. He made his way across the bar to tell me to move but not to take my order? Lol Just an uncomfortable exchange. I felt like I was bothering both the male and female tenders who's attitudes mimicked one another. I thought I'm not knocking on your bedroom door asking for a drink, I'm at the bar.... you're the tender...should be easy right? I guess they were tired? I was tired of them so I get it.  I retain my original sentiment that if the scenery could be eaten and not served it would be all good.
This place is always great.  There new waitress Paula is a breath of fresh air!  Thank you again.
The Family Meal pizza & salad were delicious & a great price. Perfect for 4 adults & 2 children. Thank You! Can't wait to order it again!!

Very nice atmosphere. Quaint and country feel. Really great food that surpasses some of the other diners I've been too. I come here to meet up with friends for breakfast. The wait staff if always friendly!
This spot Is a favorite.it's located across the James museum. The bartender here are polite n efficient. I love watching the kitchen crew n bar tender perform .

We used to order from here all the time and the last few times they have either forgotten an item Or just got our order wrong. I even left a positive review 3 years ago! The food can be good, but the portion sizes/quality are inconsistent. They always forget our chips and salsa and will make you pay for it if you try to get delivery. When we called to report our items missing, they hung up on us!!! With so many great restaurants in our area, don't waste your time here! The service is terrible, the staff is not friendly. I understand that people make mistakes but they didn't even care.

Screw this Taco Bell! The punk who works the drive-thru, Isaiah, is a rude bitch who has NO BUSINESS working with the public. I'm reporting his sorry ass to corporate. Rudest SOB I've ever dealt with. Why would Taco Bell hire worthless, POS punks to man their drive-thru? Lot of other places to eat. I won't be dealing with these assholes again. Shit food, anyway!

SATURDAY HAPPY HOUR! Cant go wrong with that....awesome outside seating for Covid-19. My group and I got almost ALL the apps and took advantage of the drink specials. I highly suggest going even if its not for happy hour! Great asian food that has a twist - Dumplings, Bao buns, Crab Rangoon (WOW!), and even sushi.

I REALLY wanted to love this place, the decor, the salute to the military...but I don't... 
    I had the meat sampler with Brisket (they have a moist and lean, I went with moist) the pulled pork and the sausage (not the jalapeño).... 

  So the pork was moist but really lacked flavor, no seasoning or anything, the sausage was bland as well and very very chewy, not because it was dry but a tough meat.... Like really chewy.  The only saving grace was the brisket, that was amazing, very good, moist and falls apart in your mouth.  They hit it outta the park with the brisket!   
   They have six different sauces on the tables and none of them really jump out at you, given the choice I would rather have Stubs... 

So to wrap this up, most of the food is average at best, the brisket is above average and sauces about average.  
 Again I really wanted to love this place.  Will I be back?  Eh maybe but i will only order the brisket

The food was ok, but I made a mistake when I ordered online. I called back to switch the order, even saying I would pay for the correct meal. I was told the delivery driver could not re-delivery anything and I would have to come in to replace the meal and bring the meal I ordered. My boyfriend went in with the incorrect meal and was given the new one. Then, charged him for the replacement, which would have been fine if they didn't take the original meal I paid $27 for. When I called to complain about this, they said my boyfriend didn't bring the meal in and lied repeatedly denying that he brought the other order in. I will never order from this lying company again. Please take your money elsewhere.

Been here several times now.  Service is fast, the pizzas come out quick.  Have tried both build your own and the margherita pizza.  All very good.  I like a crisper crust which is what you get here.  Wings are good my favorite is the bourbon bbq.  The restaurant area is clean and usually not overly crowded.  If you haven't tried it, its worth a shot at least one time.

My meal here was very good as was the service but there wasn't anything about my meal that really blew me away. When I arrived, I immediately  noticed how small the inside is. I had a reservation, but I imagine they would not be able to accommodate walk-ins at peak hours on weekends. If I were to go again, I'd definitely make a reservation. We were seated at our reservation time, and our table was small and we were very close to the table next to us. The bathroom is incredibly small. I found it to be a while after we were seated for the bread to be delivered- it was well after we ordered our entrees. The bread was warm and good, though. For the appetizer, I i ordered the grilled calamari. It was grilled perfectly and had beautiful grill marks, but it would have been delicious with marinara sauce. For an entree, I had the Pesto Gnocchi; it was delicious. The portions were generous, and I got another good dinner out of it. Overall, the meal was enjoyable,but the inside was more cramped than cozy.
This is my go-to pizza spot in West Chester. The crust is killer and it's always ready in "10 minutes". Kid friendly in the restaurant.
Place closes before when they say they are supposed to close. Old man in the back is a complete jerk. Honestly should spend your money elsewhere

My boyfriend and I are in town to finalize building a house and we decided we wanted to treat ourselves and come here. Let me tell you, it did not disappoint. 

Food was delivered quickly by our waiter Joe. He made sure it was warm, delicious and to our liking. He was very attentive, charismatic and made our time here very comfortable. Honestly one of the best we have had on a very long time. 

Atmosphere was a little weird for covid, we did not sit more than 3 feet from another table. I find this to be a trivial issue so will not let it reflect anything with my rating.

I highly recommend this place. Please be aware of the quality of food is most definitely worth the price!! Don't come here thinking it's going to be under $100 because it won't and If you want to splurge a little on fantastic food this is the place.

Knowing we just had a huge meal, we did order the creme brûlée and carrot cake to go, so I will update once we indulge :)

Very clean! Food is great, just like it is at all LaScala locations! My favorite is the calamari, LaScala Fries, Caesar salad & Penne Vodka. The Ricotta & honey board is also amazing. Highly suggest! Portions are huge!

I very much enjoyed my stay at this hotel. We came for the margarita festival. We were in building 3 with no one above or below.  We had a beautiful view of the mtns. The room was spacious and I loved the furniture in the room. Everything felt clean, light and airy. We had a slanted beam ceiling and the bathroom area was decent size with a shower and toilet with extra sink in a separate room. We ordered room service for dinner and breakfast. Served in about 45 min for both and everything was delicious. Only downfall the window coverings do not black out light. That's it.

I've recently discovered this shop.  Although disguised as a cheese and wine shop, they make the most awesome sandwiches! This was my second visit. Patrick and John were great. Patrick asked what I was in the mood for... I said,"I don't know". He proceeded to have me try lots of different meats and finally set me up with a killer combination.  I'll be coming back here again and again.

What do you expect from a pizzeria with a giant sign that says "PIZZA" out front. Listen, i love pizza. I believe in Pizza. I live. for. Pizza. Breakfast lunch and dinner, pizza. Hot Pizza cold pizza...gimme my pizza. Sometimes a beautiful fire oven roasted slightly charred crust with fine herbs, exotic cheeses and meats just aint gonna cut it. I want my pepperoni and mushroom. This place is THE place. I'm so in love. Seriously, I love you Jimmy. Don't tell my Fiancee. The cheese is gooey, the pepperoni is spicy and crunchy, the sauce is *chefs kiss*. Tomato and garlic perfection. Can you hear Dean Martin singing in the background while reading this?? "That's amore". Anyway, please go visit this place and fall in love like i did. 

oh and btw - service is great. It's a small little joint, they have beer and wine and salads too!

If there was such thing as a fast food heaven, chick-fil- a would be it. This place is fucking mental. The chicken? Slammin. The waffle fries? Poppin. Customer service? Insane. These people will literally bend over backwards and do anything to ensure their customer's upmost satisfaction. I hate even calling Chick-fil-a a fast food restaurant because it is so much better than that. On my death bed I will pass on with the company of my family, loved ones, and a spicy chicken sandwich doused in zesty buffalo sauce.

Popped in around 8pm tonight and our bartender(I think his name was Ian) was AWESOME!! Just moved here from Houston and this was my first visit. Had the fried pickles and the Blue Bull(which Ian, the bartender, recommended). The music was killer and I will definitely tell my friends to be meeting me here in the near future !

My fiancé and I visited Old Hickory to celebrate our engagement. We had a 5 o'clock reservation but got there around 4:30 and were immediately seated. The waiter was extremely knowledgeable about the menu and very friendly, and he took great care of us for our entire meal. The food is VERY pricey but it is WORTH IT! We had the Oysters Rockefeller, 8oz filet, roasted chicken, and mashed potatoes and everything was cooked perfectly and wonderful tasting. The seats look out on the Delta Gardens. Overall it was an amazing experience. We'll definitely be back!!!

Walked in took time to get seated and no one was there, finally seated and saw the back kitchen on my way not impressed saw them putting pre packaged food in a pan. Ordered water and waited. Again not busy (should have ave bbq em my first clue) no water came and I got up to leave two people standing up front not busy not sure why they  couldn't find me Somme water.

Foid was mediocre and the service was just ok.  Salty...many of the dishes we had were too salty..the battered shrimp dish so much so we could not eat it. You are paying way too much at this place for atmosphere...it's just not worth it!

Really disappointed in service last night.  This was our first time there and it will be our last.  Every customer should be treated as a regular!  Obvious attention was shown to certain tables.  Especially if someone is will to patronage your place during a pandemic.

My husband and I had a reservation at 6, we were seated immediately.

Our waitress took our drink order, came back with our sodas.  We ordered food and I ordered a glass of wine to come out with our food.

Twenty minutes later, A food runner brought out our food.

We completed our meal and our waitress finally showed again and asked how everything was.  My husband reminded her that I ordered a glass of wine.

The waitresses response was, "You have to remind me, I didn't put it in because you wanted it with dinner."

I'm sorry- 1-not my job to remind you to do your job and 2-when would I have reminded you?  You haven't been to our table in 30 minutes 

Again, staff CLEARLY bent over backward for regulars and the obvious older patrons. 

I will not recommend your establishment to anyone and will not be back!

We came there to celebrate my birthday and because it was highly recommended.

Brew Dog in Fountain Square would like to thank you for our after dinner drinks!

Just inside of a Korean market hides this gem know as Dosi Rak or  in Korean this the a word for a lunch box with rice, sides and a main course being meat or veggie.  Gal bi or Korean short ribs are one of my favorite Korean dishes and Dosi rak does it really well, nothing beats cooking it fresh at a KBBQ place but if you're looking for a Togo option especially in these Covid times, you won't be disappointed.
The Bulgogi is also really good and a very common Korean bbq item.  If your are new to Korean food and like beef, you need to try Bulgogi which translate to Fire meat.
Staff at Dosi rak is friendly and helpful
Food pricing is pretty normal for Korean food
Food it really good.
I highly recommend and I hope you enjoy Korean food as much as I do!!
I've had better.  The cheese steak needed more salt.
This is my favorite restaurant in Tampa. Hard to find places that have fresh delicious food without being overseasoned. Every dish is great. Great service. Finally some good food in this city!!!
Always been my favorite place for pizza! They've got it down to perfection! I've never had a slice be soggy or doughy. Staff is friendly and service is fast.

Excellent burger spot!! I was introduced to this restaurant when we had our first baby at st Vincent's. 

After cooking at home soo much, we were craving something tasty and delicious, and this place hit the spot.  The burgers were fresh and cooked perfectly.  I was a little worried that the fries would get soggy from the steam in the Togo containers. So I arrived a few minutes before the stated pick up time, our order was ready, and even after the 15 minute drive home, everything was hot and the fries were still crispy and delicious!

Their contactless pickup was a seamless and well oiled machine. Drove up, gave them our name, and within minutes they were back out with our order and there were like 5 other cars there picking up.  Super smooth process, thank you!!

We came here for dinner on Saturday evening.  The dining space is extremely small comprising about twelve tables that are within arms reach of each other.   The room was loud and made conversation difficult.   Our waitress was nice but seemed overwhelmed when she had to greet and sit customers as they arrived as well as take orders.  She would not let us put in our appetizers as we looked at the menu.  She stated the kitchen needed the whole order at one time.   This seemed rather odd and was off putting.   What kind of professional kitchen cannot handle orders as they are placed?
We ordered the sardine special and shrimp with beans as our appetizers.   The shrimp far exceeded the sardines in flavor.   I ordered the carbonara pasta which was the best part of my meal.   I wish I would have ordered the large portion as my meal.  The fisherman's stew was ordered without calamari but came with it.   I sent it back and our waitress literally told me they just picked it out.   It came back in under a minute.  Well, I could have done that myself.   For $27, make me a brand new dish!!!  My friend ordered the rabbit which was underwhelming.  Although we both knew it was not chicken, it lacked any real flavor.   The potatoes were better then the rabbit.   We shared the pistachio gelato which was homemade.   
While we are glad we finally were able to eat here, we would probably not return.

This was my first experience dining at this restaurant.  The wait was approximately 30 minutes for a table of four.  The food was above average and had no issues there.  We were seated in a banquet area with a huge party next to us.  The tables were covered in paper and it was if we were not allowed in the actual restaurant.  The temperature continually went from hot to cold as the waitress turned up the heat and the manager turned it down.  Overall not the greatest atmosphere in the side section we were forced to sit at.
When in Philly, hit the Prime. Best place to overindulged. Everything was fantastic and our server was the crowning touch.  This is a stop for me every time I am in Philly!

Roast chicken and rice with meat. Delicious food, chicken is juicy and rice spectacular. The place super cute, the staff very attentive. I love it I recommend it 100%

We bought a gift card through a local school event and thought it would be a nice, easy date. We didn't have high expectations since it's just a basic chain restaurant, but we were beyond disappointed with our food. The hot rolls and peanuts were basically the only thing worth eating. (Please note, the rolls are really only good when hot). I ordered a fillet with a side of shrimp and mixed veggies. My husband ordered the fried catfish. Based on the menu description of how they cook their meat, I ordered mine medium well (menu description defined this as "some pink".) Nope. No pink. Overcooked (way beyond pink). The shrimp had a nice flavor but they were cold (not room temp. But partially cold -like when you heat something in the microwave and portions get warm and other portions don't.) my veggies were raw. Not even cooked. Raw baby carrots and raw broccoli with a glob of unmelted butter in the middle. I honestly think they forgot to cook/steam them. My husbands fish was the texture of mashed potatoes. He could only eat half. If it had just been one or two things we may have said something. But it was just so over the top BAD it wasn't even worth it. We will never visit another Texas Roadhouse. So sad that these restaurants have become nothing more than an over priced TV dinner that's not even cooked correctly.
